C1127.title: Shanghai Qumo Culture Communication Co., Ltd. False Advertising Case
C1127.summary: From December 2020 through February 2021, Shanghai Qumo Culture Communication Co., Ltd. recruited 400 social media influencers to publish promotional posts about invisible braces on Xiaohongshu. The influencers were neither patients nor actual users of the product but posted usage experiences and positive reviews based on centrally prepared copy. In March 2022, the Pudong New Area Market Supervision Bureau found that the conduct violated the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, ordered it stopped, and imposed a 450,000-yuan fine.

references.title: Shanghai Market Supervision Bureau: 2022 Typical Cases of Illegal Click Farming and Fake Reviews
